# resumereaderapi v1.0.0 - Table of Contents

> Elixir client for the Resume Reader API: parse PDF, DOCX and scanned resumes into 114 structured JSON fields, and normalize job titles, skills and locations.

## Pages

- [resumereaderapi for Elixir](readme.md)

## Modules

- [ResumeReaderApi](ResumeReaderApi.md): Client for the Resume Reader API: resume parsing into 114 structured fields,
plus job title, skill and location normalization.
